question: U, V and W together can complete a work in 10 days. If U can work thrice as faster than V and V can work twice as faster than W, then in how many days W alone can complete the same work?
solution:
**Given:**

 U, V and W together can complete a work in 10 days.

 U can work thrice as faster than V and V can work twice as faster than W
